## Working title

<!-- One line. Headlines can change in edit; we just need a handle. -->

## Section

<!-- Pick one: governance · research · development · cryptography · culture · dispatches -->

## Thesis (3–5 sentences)

<!--
What is the argument? What is the news peg, the evidence, or the
unexamined assumption you intend to take apart? Be specific. We pass on
pitches that read like syllabus entries; we commission pitches that have
a thesis we could defend in a hostile room.
-->

## Why now

<!-- The temporal hook. A post-mortem, a fork, a vote, a paper, a moment. -->

## Why you

<!--
What can you see that another writer cannot? Domain experience,
documents, a relevant PR, a research line. One paragraph.
-->

## Length and shape

<!-- Roughly: 800 (dispatch) · 1500 (essay) · 3000+ (long-form). -->

## Conflicts of interest

<!--
Holdings, employment, advisory, grants, prior work for any entity named
in the piece. We publish the disclosure with the article. Better
declared than discovered.
-->
